status: Estimate: low-risk B/C stock-keeping pilot; insurance excluded; all release requires review, not an approved disposition budget

horizon.source: Evaluation horizon; no terminal salvage assumed

discount.source: Illustrative before-tax discount rate; finance approval required

scope.source: Share of the deduplicated B/C stock-keeping cohort, not all plant replenishment

release_realisation.source: Assumption aligned with the case savings page: 30% of deduplicated B/C candidates realised over three years; not observed cash

procurement_execution.source: Base stock-keeping pilot does not execute the full dynamic-order backlog. For a funded availability programme, enter the reviewed incremental share of that backlog separately.

holding_cash_rate.source: Avoidable storage/handling/insurance cash cost only. Excludes financing return to avoid double counting capital release

holding_economic_rate.source: Total carrying-rate policy from engine; economic indicator, not added to cash NPV

emergency_spend.source: Eligible historical emergency purchase spend Not in baseline data; zero benefit until evidenced

emergency_premium.source: Baseline evidence: relative unit price 1.00 in every lead band and purchase type. No rush price premium supported; emergency saving locked at zero.

emergency_avoidance.source: Fraction of emergency purchasing avoided; requires pilot verification

downtime_days_S.source: Incremental avoided production-critical-path days Not in baseline data; excludes overlap with other criticality classes

downtime_days_A.source: Incremental avoided days Not in baseline data

downtime_days_B.source: Incremental avoided days Not in baseline data

downtime_days_C.source: Incremental avoided days Not in baseline data

cost_day_S.source: Policy consequence only, not a measured plant contribution margin

integration.source: Implementation allowance, not a vendor quotation

data_review.source: Part master, ownership, Min/Max and procurement-price validation allowance

security.source: Identity, read-only service, logging and security review allowance

training.source: Buyer, planner and maintenance reviewer training allowance

hardware.source: Existing browser clients; no GPU required for deterministic engine or managed model API

cloud_software.source: Hosting, model API, database, logs and backup budget; validate with workload and supplier pricing

owner_support.source: Incremental service ownership and support allowance

evaluation.source: Forecast backtesting, critical-spare review and ongoing data QA allowance

critical_review_share.source: 10% after-review critical-cohort illustration, aligned with the savings page; excludes insurance and is not approved release

critical_scenario_enabled.source: Scenario toggle only: include the reviewed S/A cohort hypothesis. Zero in base case; changing this does not grant engineering approval.
